response:
## 1) Severity: HIGH | Type: Bug
Title: Detach background legacy writes from the request context

Affected:
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:50-57
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:108-114
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:134-141
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:161-167

Explanation:
Each goroutine builds its timeout context from the incoming request `ctx`. The handler returns right after starting the goroutine. The apiserver then cancels the request context, so the legacy `Create`/`Update`/`Delete`/`DeleteCollection` is usually cancelled before or during execution.

As a result, legacy storage silently stops receiving writes in mode 3. This defeats the purpose of dual writing, and it will also make the new mode 3 integration tests flaky wherever they verify data through the legacy API. The 10s timeout only bounds the call; it does not extend the parent's lifetime.

Proposed fix:
~~~go
go func(ctx context.Context) {
    ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeoutCause(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 10*time.Second, errors.New("legacy create timeout"))
    defer cancel()
    ...
}(ctx)
~~~

## 2) Severity: MEDIUM | Type: Bug
Title: Fix metrics recorded against the wrong store or with the wrong label

Affected:
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:45
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:106
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:129
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:166

Explanation:
Several metric calls are mislabelled:
- **Create (line 45) and Update (line 129):** a failure in *unified storage* is recorded with `recordLegacyDuration`.
- **DeleteCollection (line 166):** the *legacy* goroutine records with `recordStorageDuration`.
- **Delete success (line 106):** `name` is passed as the `kind` label. This is wrong, and it also creates unbounded label cardinality, one series per object name.

Together these make the storage/legacy latency and error metrics wrong. The cardinality problem can also bloat Prometheus.

Proposed fix:
~~~go
// Create / Update error paths
d.recordStorageDuration(true, mode3Str, options.Kind, method, startStorage)
// Delete success
d.recordStorageDuration(false, mode3Str, options.Kind, method, startStorage)
// DeleteCollection goroutine
d.recordLegacyDuration(err != nil, mode3Str, options.Kind, method, startLegacy)
~~~

## 3) Severity: MEDIUM | Type: Bug
Title: Propagate the unified-store result to the legacy update instead of re-applying objInfo

Affected:
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:139

Explanation:
The previous code passed the object returned by `Storage.Update` to legacy via `updateWrapper`. The new code passes the raw `objInfo` to `Legacy.Update`, so legacy recomputes the update against its own (possibly divergent) old object. Two problems follow:
- The two stores can diverge.
- Any preconditions or resourceVersion carried by `objInfo` that belong to the unified store can cause the legacy update to fail.

These failures are not logged (see issue 4).

`objInfo` is also used concurrently in a goroutine after the request returns. Whether that is safe depends on the concrete implementation, which is outside this diff.

Proposed fix:
~~~go
_, _, errObjectSt := d.Legacy.Update(ctx, name, &updateWrapper{upstream: objInfo, updated: res},
    createValidation, updateValidation, forceAllowCreate, options)
~~~

## 4) Severity: MEDIUM | Type: Reliability
Title: Log failures of the asynchronous legacy writes

Affected:
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:55-56
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:112-113
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:139-140
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:165-166

Explanation:
The old code logged legacy write failures. The new goroutines only bump a metric. Combined with the cancellation issue above, legacy drift becomes invisible and cannot be debugged. Also, Delete stores `d.Log` instead of the enriched `log` in the context (line 97), so downstream logs lose the name, kind and method values.

Proposed fix:
~~~go
if errObjectSt != nil {
    log.Error(errObjectSt, "unable to create object in legacy storage")
}
// and in Delete:
ctx = klog.NewContext(ctx, log)
~~~

## 5) Severity: LOW | Type: Test
Title: Make the mode 3 unit tests separate the two stores and wait for the async legacy calls

Affected:
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3_test.go:28-44
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3_test.go:305-325

Explanation:
`legacyStoreMock` and `storageMock` share the same `mock.Mock`, so the two stores cannot be told apart:
- **Create error case:** this case is named "unified store fails" but only configures `setupLegacyFn`. The storage `Create` call is what actually matches that expectation.
- **Update test:** the legacy and storage `Update` expectations are identical, so either one satisfies both calls.
- **Legacy goroutines:** the test never waits for them or asserts them, so the legacy path is effectively untested.

Proposed fix:
~~~text
Use separate mocks for legacy and storage. Then use m.AssertExpectations
with assert.Eventually (or a sync hook) to verify the legacy call happens.
~~~

## 6) Severity: LOW | Type: Maintainability
Title: Remove duplicate go.work.sum entry

Affected:
- go.work.sum:408

Explanation:
Line 408 duplicates line 404 (`github.com/grafana/grafana/pkg/apimachinery v0.0.0-20240701135906-559738ce6ae1/go.mod`). This looks like a bad merge rather than a `go work sync` result. Regenerate the file instead of hand-merging.

Proposed fix:
~~~text
go work sync   # or delete the duplicate line 408
~~~
